name: The Last Clan: Tale of Oni
source:
Narasaki: home to the last clan of Oni. Moriko's tranquil life is shattered when her father, the clan head, is burdened with a mysterious illness. Soon, however, her clansmen learn about a magical artifact that could save him but cause great danger when held in the wrong hands.

[From [url=https://neeka-of-obp.itch.io/the-last-clan-tale-of-oni-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
楢崎：鬼最后一族的故乡。当她的族长父亲患上了神秘的疾病时，森子平静的生活被打破了。然而很快，她的族人得知一件神奇的神器可以拯救他，但如果落入错误的人手中，就会造成巨大的危险。

[来自[url=https://neeka-of-obp.itch.io/the-last-clan-tale-of-oni-demo]itch.io[/url]]
